versions.name: RXV2-0.9.326-fast-lane-update
versions.notes: Updates take the fastest road automatically: when the receiver's own WiFi is connected, installs download at WiFi speed even when you're using the app over Bluetooth (30-90 s instead of minutes). Bluetooth streaming remains the automatic fallback at the field.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.325-gear-field-fix
versions.notes: The gear-ratio box no longer fights your typing — the page's background refresh was rewriting it mid-keystroke. Type, save, done.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.324-current-lag-note
versions.notes: Flight-analysis help now explains why current seems to lag head speed on spool-up: the ESC smooths and reports current more slowly than RPM — the reporting lags, not the motor.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.323-square-events
versions.notes: Graph: real events (motor on/off, battery plugged in) now draw square — the flat holds its full length and the change is steep at the moment it happened. Only gentle one-unit sensor steps are smoothed into slopes.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.322-straight-slopes
versions.notes: Graph lines are now straight slopes with gently rounded corners instead of sweeping curves — sparse data no longer swoops like a sine wave.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.321-steady-hand
versions.notes: Graph refinement: a governed head speed now draws truly FLAT — small sensor jitter (a few rpm, hundredths of a volt) is treated as steadiness rather than continuous change, especially visible on short flights. Real changes still slope exactly as before.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.320-smooth-curves
versions.notes: The flight graph now draws real slopes instead of staircases: each sensor's discrete steps are turned back into the smooth curve the quantity actually followed. And when reviewing offline, the tuning pages now honestly say 'Loaded from the phone' / 'Reload from phone'.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.319-fool-armour
versions.notes: Guard rails for busy fingers: the save-to-phone panel warns not to switch the transmitter on or the model off mid-save, and the apps now abort bank switching instantly (restoring the model's own banks) if the transmitter appears mid-save. Sending offline edits re-checks the transmitter at the moment you press Send, shows what to keep on/off, and NEVER loses edits if a step fails — they are kept for another try. Plus: the app now keeps a separate recorded session PER MODEL; connecting a different model no longer erases the previous one's.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.318-flight-list-fix
versions.notes: Fixes 'all my flights are gone': the flight LIST broke the moment flights gained real dates (a 64-byte line buffer truncated the JSON) — the flight data itself was always safe on the receiver. All saved flights reappear.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.317-honest-save
versions.notes: When reviewing offline in the app, the Rotorflight save buttons now tell the truth: 'Save to phone', with matching confirmations and '✓ Saved on the phone — ready to send at the next connection' messages (copy-to-profile too). The governor page no longer pretends to reboot a flight controller that isn't there.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.316-progress-bar
versions.notes: Saving the session to the phone now shows a solid, readable progress panel with a real progress bar. Offline edits made in review are no longer discarded when you connect with the transmitter on — they are kept until sent (transmitter off) or overwritten by newer edits.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.315-solid-text
versions.notes: Solid, readable text everywhere: cards, banners, titles and messages now sit on solid backgrounds (no more translucency washing out in sunlight). Rotorflight settings are now saved and reviewed PER BANK (all 4 PID banks + 4 rate banks, transmitter off), offline edits remember their bank, and the Save-session button no longer appears while reviewing.
